name: dialogram
description: Dialogram — talk to your diagrams. GLSP diagram platform with integrated agent chat, consumed by other extensions through its exported API.
author: Endri Bezati

workflow.chat.enableMcpTools.description: Expose the in-host read-only registry MCP tools (list_task_types, get_graph, validate_workflow, ...) to the chat agent.

dialogram.chat.useGlspMcp.description: Hand the chat agent the in-host GLSP-MCP diagram server, whose tools (create-task-type, create-nodes, create-edges, modify-*, delete-elements) make undoable edits through the editor's undo stack. Turn off to fall back to the read-only in-host registry server only: reads still work, but the agent can no longer make undoable diagram edits and any mutation happens via direct (non-undoable) file edits. (Legacy `workflow.chat.useGlspMcp` is still honoured.)

dialogram.chat.autoLayoutAfterEdits.description: Automatically re-run layout after the chat agent edits the diagram.

dialogram.chat.checkSourceRevision.description: Reject chat edits when the source file changed since the last read (optimistic concurrency).

scripts.build:clean: npm run clean && npm run build
